Talent Tree Overview

Shared tree with vocation depth

The Talent Tree is a character progression layer. Players earn Talent Points by leveling and completing key milestones, then spend them across a shared tree. The tree is shared across all vocations, with deeper nodes becoming vocation-specific.

04

Notables

Generic and vocation notables

Generic notables include unlocking +1 Awakening Spell Slot, +1 Glyph Slot, +1 Soul Shard Slot, gaining Attack Power from Awakening Levels, full Attack Speed counting toward ranged weapons when dual wielding, increasing Attack Speed cap, and increasing Cooldown Reduction cap.

Vocation notables exist for every vocation and specialization, giving class-specific modifiers such as range, damage scaling, summons, healing, tanking, attack speed cap, cooldown behavior, marks, and resource interactions.
